## support package

Shared primitives every framework package builds on.

## Remarks

This package is deliberately inert: it imports nothing, declares no peer dependency and performs no I/O. That rule is what keeps it from becoming the junk drawer every monorepo eventually grows — anything needing a socket, a file handle or a third-party module belongs in the package that owns it.

It supplies three things:

- [loadDriver()](./support.loaddriver.md)<!-- -->, for importing an optional peer dependency lazily and failing with an install hint rather than a stack trace. - [envString()](./support.envstring.md)<!-- -->, [envBoolean()](./support.envboolean.md)<!-- -->, [envNumber()](./support.envnumber.md) and [envChoice()](./support.envchoice.md)<!-- -->, the vocabulary every package's `configFromEnv` is written in. - [Manager](./support.manager.md)<!-- -->, the driver-resolution base class that gives every package the same shape: free construction, lazy resolution, one instance per name.
